_doc: Role templates, grouped by family (families.json, which also sets each family's seniority ladder and typical years). title / arch: the role's job title and its architect-tier title, used to suggest headlines; title_by_level overrides the family's title pattern for a tier, and head fills {h} in 'Head of {h}'. years: per-tier [min, max] overriding the family's bands. skills: each entry is a group of skill ids (any one satisfies it) with a weight: 3 = core, 2 = important, 1 = nice to have; 'from': '<tier>' makes a group count only at that tier and above (what a senior/lead/architect in the role is additionally expected to show). titles: phrases that identify the role in job titles, with how strongly they indicate it (0-1).

platform.label: Platform Engineering
platform.title: Platform Engineer
platform.description: Platform engineer building an internal developer platform on Kubernetes and public cloud: infrastructure as code with Terraform, GitOps delivery with Argo CD, golden paths and self-service templates, Kubernetes operators, service mesh, observability, policy as code and developer experience for product teams.

devops.label: DevOps
devops.title: DevOps Engineer
devops.description: DevOps engineer automating build, test and release: CI/CD pipelines with Jenkins, GitHub Actions or GitLab CI, Docker and Kubernetes deployments, infrastructure as code with Terraform and Ansible, cloud operations on AWS, Azure or GCP, Linux administration, scripting in Bash and Python, monitoring and DevSecOps scanning.

sre.label: Site Reliability Engineering
sre.title: Site Reliability Engineer
sre.description: Site reliability engineer owning production reliability: SLOs, SLIs and error budgets, incident response and on-call, blameless postmortems, observability with Prometheus, Grafana and OpenTelemetry, capacity planning, performance and load testing, chaos engineering, Linux and networking depth, automation in Go or Python, Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure.

cloud_eng.label: Cloud Engineering
cloud_eng.title: Cloud Engineer
cloud_eng.description: Cloud engineer designing, provisioning and running workloads on AWS, Azure or Google Cloud: VPC and cloud networking, IAM and security controls, infrastructure as code with Terraform or CloudFormation, containers and Kubernetes, serverless, CI/CD, monitoring, backup and cost optimisation, migrations from on-premises and cloud certifications.

sysadmin.label: Systems Administration
sysadmin.title: Systems Administrator
sysadmin.description: Systems administrator running servers and infrastructure: Linux and Windows Server administration, Active Directory, DNS and DHCP, VMware or Hyper-V virtualisation, backup and recovery with Veeam, patch management, monitoring with Nagios or Zabbix, PowerShell and Bash scripting, storage, Microsoft 365, ticketing with ServiceNow and ITIL processes.

network_eng.label: Network Engineering
network_eng.title: Network Engineer
network_eng.description: Network engineer designing and operating enterprise and data-centre networks: routing and switching with BGP, OSPF, VLANs and MPLS, Cisco, Juniper or Arista, firewalls such as Palo Alto and Fortinet, VPN, SD-WAN, wireless, F5 load balancers, cloud networking, network monitoring, troubleshooting with Wireshark and automation with Python and Ansible; CCNA/CCNP.

dba.label: Database Administration
dba.title: Database Administrator
dba.description: Database administrator keeping databases fast, safe and available: Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL or MySQL installation, upgrades and patching, backup and recovery with RMAN, replication and high availability with Data Guard, RAC or Always On, performance and query tuning, security, monitoring, cloud databases such as RDS, scripting and automation.

aiops.label: AIOps
aiops.title: AIOps Engineer
aiops.description: AIOps engineer applying machine learning to IT operations: anomaly detection on metrics and logs, event and alert correlation to reduce noise, automated root cause analysis, auto-remediation and runbook automation, observability platforms, ITSM integration with ServiceNow, forecasting and predictive operations, Python automation and incident management.

automation.label: Automation (Infra & Ops)
automation.title: Automation Engineer
automation.description: Automation engineer eliminating manual work: scripting and tooling in Python and Bash, test automation with Selenium, Playwright, Cypress or pytest, CI/CD pipeline integration, infrastructure and configuration automation with Ansible and Terraform, workflow and process automation, RPA, API integration, runbook automation and quality engineering.

data_eng.label: Data Engineering
data_eng.title: Data Engineer
data_eng.description: Data engineer building reliable data pipelines and platforms: batch and streaming ETL/ELT with Spark, Kafka and Airflow, SQL and Python, data warehouses such as Snowflake, BigQuery or Redshift, lakehouse with Databricks and Delta Lake, dbt, data modelling, data quality and testing, cloud data services on AWS, Azure or GCP, CI/CD and governance.

data_sci.label: Data Science
data_sci.title: Data Scientist
data_sci.description: Data scientist turning data into decisions and models: statistics and hypothesis testing, machine learning with scikit-learn, XGBoost and deep learning, feature engineering, model evaluation, A/B testing and causal inference, Python with pandas and NumPy, SQL, data visualisation, NLP or computer vision, forecasting and communicating insights to stakeholders.

data_analyst.label: Data Analytics
data_analyst.title: Data Analyst
data_analyst.description: Data analyst answering business questions with data: SQL queries, Excel with pivot tables and VLOOKUP, dashboards in Power BI or Tableau, data cleaning and preparation, descriptive statistics, KPIs and reporting, Python or R for analysis, A/B test readouts and presenting insights and recommendations to stakeholders.

bi_dev.label: BI Development
bi_dev.title: BI Developer
bi_dev.description: Business intelligence developer delivering reporting and analytics: Power BI with DAX and Power Query, Tableau, SSRS and SSAS, SQL and stored procedures, data warehouse and dimensional modelling with star schemas, ETL with SSIS, Informatica or Azure Data Factory, KPI dashboards and performance tuning of reports.

sql_dev.label: SQL / Database Development
sql_dev.title: SQL Developer
sql_dev.description: SQL and database developer writing and optimising database code: complex SQL queries, PL/SQL or T-SQL stored procedures, functions and triggers, Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL or MySQL, query tuning and indexing, data modelling and normalised schemas, ETL with SSIS or Informatica, reports and data migration.

ml_eng.label: ML Engineering
ml_eng.title: Machine Learning Engineer
ml_eng.description: Machine learning engineer developing and productionising models: feature engineering, model training and hyperparameter tuning with PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn or XGBoost, model evaluation and A/B testing, deep learning for NLP or computer vision, data pipelines with Spark and SQL, model deployment and serving, experiment tracking and GPU training.

ai_eng.label: AI Engineering
ai_eng.title: AI Engineer
ai_eng.description: AI engineer building LLM-powered products: retrieval augmented generation with embeddings and vector databases, AI agents with tool use and function calling, prompt engineering, LLM evaluation and guardrails, frameworks like LangChain or LlamaIndex, OpenAI, Anthropic or Bedrock APIs, Python backend services and APIs, fine-tuning and model serving.

mlops.label: MLOps
mlops.title: MLOps Engineer
mlops.description: MLOps engineer running the machine learning lifecycle in production: ML pipelines and continuous training, ML platforms such as MLflow, Kubeflow, SageMaker or Vertex AI, model serving with KServe, Seldon or Triton, model registry and versioning, model monitoring and drift detection, experiment tracking, feature stores, CI/CD for models, Docker, Kubernetes and Terraform on cloud, GPU infrastructure.

ml_ai_ops_eng.label: ML/AI Ops & Engineering
ml_ai_ops_eng.title: ML/AI Platform Engineer
ml_ai_ops_eng.description: Hybrid ML and AI engineer who both builds and operates models and LLM systems: model training and fine-tuning, RAG and LLM applications, ML pipelines and ML platforms, model and LLM serving with vLLM, Triton or KServe, LLMOps, evaluation and monitoring for drift and quality, GPU infrastructure on Kubernetes, CI/CD and infrastructure as code on cloud.

backend.label: Backend Development
backend.title: Backend Developer
backend.description: Backend developer building server-side services and APIs: Java, Python, Go, C# or Node.js, REST and GraphQL APIs, relational and NoSQL databases, microservices, messaging with Kafka or RabbitMQ, caching with Redis, Docker and Kubernetes, CI/CD, unit and integration testing, cloud services and scalable distributed system design.

frontend.label: Frontend Development
frontend.title: Frontend Developer
frontend.description: Frontend developer building responsive web interfaces: JavaScript and TypeScript, React, Angular or Vue, HTML5 and CSS3 with Sass or Tailwind, state management with Redux, REST and GraphQL integration, unit testing with Jest and end-to-end tests with Cypress or Playwright, webpack or Vite, accessibility, web performance and design systems with Figma handoff.

fullstack.label: Full-Stack Development
fullstack.title: Full Stack Developer
fullstack.description: Full-stack developer delivering features end to end: React, Angular or Vue front ends with TypeScript, HTML and CSS, back-end services in Node.js, Java, Python, C# or PHP, REST and GraphQL APIs, SQL and NoSQL databases, authentication, Docker, CI/CD, cloud deployment on AWS or Azure, testing and Git workflows.

mobile.label: Mobile Development
mobile.title: Mobile Developer
mobile.description: Mobile developer building iOS and Android apps: Swift and SwiftUI or Kotlin and Jetpack Compose, cross-platform Flutter or React Native, MVVM and clean architecture, REST APIs, offline storage, push notifications with Firebase, unit and UI testing, CI/CD with Fastlane and publishing to the App Store and Google Play.

java_dev.label: Java Development
java_dev.title: Java Developer
java_dev.description: Java developer building enterprise applications and microservices: core Java and J2EE, Spring Boot, Spring MVC and Spring Security, Hibernate and JPA, REST APIs, SQL databases such as Oracle, MySQL or PostgreSQL, Maven or Gradle, JUnit and Mockito, Kafka, Docker, Jenkins and cloud deployment.

dotnet_dev.label: .NET Development
dotnet_dev.title: .NET Developer
dotnet_dev.description: .NET developer building applications on the Microsoft stack: C#, ASP.NET Core and Web API, MVC, Entity Framework and LINQ, SQL Server with T-SQL, Azure App Service and Functions, Angular or React front ends, unit testing with xUnit or NUnit, Azure DevOps pipelines and microservices.

python_dev.label: Python Development
python_dev.title: Python Developer
python_dev.description: Python developer building web services, automation and data applications: Python 3, Django, Flask or FastAPI, REST APIs, SQL and ORMs such as SQLAlchemy, PostgreSQL and Redis, Celery and asyncio, pytest, Docker, Linux, AWS, pandas and NumPy for data processing, Git and CI/CD.

embedded_sw.label: Embedded Software
embedded_sw.title: Embedded Software Engineer
embedded_sw.description: Embedded software engineer writing firmware close to hardware: embedded C and C++, microcontrollers such as ARM Cortex-M and STM32, RTOS like FreeRTOS or Zephyr, device drivers, I2C, SPI, UART and CAN, embedded Linux with Yocto, bootloaders, debugging with JTAG and oscilloscopes, unit testing, MISRA and AUTOSAR for automotive.

sap.label: SAP
sap.title: SAP Consultant
sap.description: SAP consultant implementing and supporting SAP ERP: S/4HANA and ECC, functional modules such as FICO, MM, SD or PP, or ABAP development with RICEF objects, BAPIs, BADIs and IDocs, Fiori and SAPUI5, HANA CDS views, integration with SAP PI/PO or CPI, end-to-end implementations, go-live, hypercare and support.

salesforce.label: Salesforce
salesforce.title: Salesforce Developer
salesforce.description: Salesforce developer and consultant customising the Salesforce platform: Apex classes and triggers, SOQL, Lightning Web Components and Aura, Visualforce, flows and declarative configuration, Sales Cloud and Service Cloud, integrations with REST APIs and MuleSoft, deployments with SFDX and Copado, security model and Salesforce certifications.

servicenow_dev.label: ServiceNow
servicenow_dev.title: ServiceNow Developer
servicenow_dev.description: ServiceNow developer configuring and extending the Now Platform: ITSM incident, problem and change, ITOM, CMDB and Discovery, HRSD or CSM, JavaScript with GlideRecord, business rules, client scripts and script includes, Service Portal, Flow Designer and IntegrationHub, REST integrations, ITIL processes and ServiceNow certifications.

qa_automation.label: Automation QA / SDET
qa_automation.title: QA Automation Engineer
qa_automation.description: QA automation engineer and SDET building automated test suites: Selenium WebDriver, Playwright or Cypress, Java, Python or JavaScript, TestNG, JUnit or pytest, API testing with Postman and Rest Assured, BDD with Cucumber, page object model frameworks, CI/CD with Jenkins, mobile testing with Appium, test management in Jira and Agile delivery.

qa_manual.label: QA / Manual Testing
qa_manual.title: QA Engineer
qa_manual.description: QA analyst and software tester ensuring releases work: manual, functional, regression, smoke and exploratory testing, writing test plans, test scenarios and test cases, requirement traceability, defect logging and tracking in Jira, API testing with Postman, SQL for data validation, UAT support, mobile and cross-browser testing, Agile ceremonies and ISTQB practices.

perf_test.label: Performance Testing
perf_test.title: Performance Test Engineer
perf_test.description: Performance test engineer making systems fast and scalable: load, stress, soak and spike testing with JMeter, LoadRunner, Gatling, k6 or NeoLoad, workload modelling, correlation and parameterisation, APM with Dynatrace, AppDynamics or New Relic, profiling, heap and thread dumps, JVM and database tuning, capacity planning and CI integration.

sec_eng.label: Security Engineering
sec_eng.title: Security Engineer
sec_eng.description: Security engineer protecting systems end to end: vulnerability management with Nessus or Qualys, application security and OWASP Top 10, SIEM and log monitoring, EDR, network security with firewalls, IDS/IPS and WAF, IAM, encryption and PKI, threat modelling, incident response, scripting in Python, cloud security and compliance with ISO 27001 or SOC 2.

cloud_sec.label: Cloud Security
cloud_sec.title: Cloud Security Engineer
cloud_sec.description: Cloud security engineer securing AWS, Azure and Google Cloud: IAM and least privilege, CSPM and CNAPP tools such as Wiz or Prisma Cloud, GuardDuty and Security Hub, Kubernetes and container security, infrastructure as code scanning and policy as code, secrets management and KMS, network segmentation, logging and detection, compliance with CIS benchmarks, SOC 2 and ISO 27001.

soc_analyst.label: SOC Analysis
soc_analyst.title: SOC Analyst
soc_analyst.description: SOC analyst monitoring and responding to threats around the clock: SIEM monitoring and alert triage in Splunk, QRadar or Microsoft Sentinel, EDR investigations with CrowdStrike or Defender, incident handling and escalation, threat hunting, threat intelligence and MITRE ATT&CK, phishing and malware analysis, playbooks and SOAR, network traffic analysis and reporting.

pentester.label: Penetration Testing
pentester.title: Penetration Tester
pentester.description: Penetration tester and ethical hacker finding vulnerabilities before attackers do: web application and API testing against the OWASP Top 10, network and Active Directory penetration testing, red teaming, Burp Suite, Metasploit, Nmap and Kali Linux, exploitation and privilege escalation, scripting in Python and Bash, clear reporting of findings and remediation; OSCP.

grc.label: GRC & Risk
grc.title: GRC Analyst
grc.description: Governance, risk and compliance analyst managing security risk and audits: ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST CSF, PCI DSS and GDPR programmes, risk assessments and risk registers, third-party and vendor risk, policies and procedures, internal and external audits, controls testing and evidence collection, GRC tools such as Archer or OneTrust, and data privacy.

mech_design.label: Mechanical Design
mech_design.title: Mechanical Design Engineer
mech_design.description: Mechanical design engineer developing products and machines: 3D CAD modelling in SolidWorks, CATIA, Creo or NX, 2D engineering drawings with GD&T and tolerance stack-up, design calculations, FEA with ANSYS, DFM and DFA, sheet metal, casting and plastic part design, material selection, DFMEA, prototyping and validation, BOMs and PLM such as Teamcenter or Windchill.

cad_designer.label: CAD / BIM Design & Drafting
cad_designer.title: CAD Designer
cad_designer.description: CAD designer and draughtsman producing accurate drawings and models: AutoCAD 2D drafting, 3D modelling in SolidWorks, Inventor or Revit, general arrangement, fabrication and shop drawings, detailing to drawing standards, GD&T, bills of materials, BIM coordination with Navisworks, sheet metal and piping or steel detailing, drawing revisions and document control.

electrical.label: Electrical Engineering
electrical.title: Electrical Engineer
electrical.description: Electrical engineer designing power and control systems: power distribution, switchgear, transformers and substations, single line diagrams, load calculations, cable sizing, earthing and lighting design, load flow, short circuit and protection studies in ETAP, AutoCAD Electrical or EPLAN, PLC and SCADA, motors and VFDs, testing and commissioning to IEC, IEEE and NEC standards.

civil_struct.label: Civil / Structural Engineering
civil_struct.title: Structural Engineer
civil_struct.description: Civil and structural engineer designing buildings and infrastructure: structural analysis and design of RCC and steel structures and foundations, STAAD Pro, ETABS, SAP2000 or Tekla, design codes such as IS 456, ACI 318, Eurocode and AISC, AutoCAD and Revit, BIM coordination, seismic design, quantity estimation and BOQ, site supervision and execution, scheduling with Primavera.

electronics_hw.label: Electronics / Hardware Design
electronics_hw.title: Hardware Design Engineer
electronics_hw.description: Electronics hardware design engineer taking boards from schematic to production: analog, digital and mixed-signal circuit design, power supplies and DC-DC converters, microcontrollers and interfaces, schematic capture and PCB layout in Altium, OrCAD or Allegro, SPICE simulation, signal and power integrity, board bring-up with oscilloscopes, EMC/EMI compliance, DFM and FPGA.

vlsi.label: VLSI / Chip Design
vlsi.title: VLSI Design Engineer
vlsi.description: VLSI engineer designing and verifying silicon: RTL design in Verilog and SystemVerilog, design verification with UVM, constrained random tests, assertions and coverage closure, synthesis and static timing analysis, physical design, DFT, AMBA AXI, PCIe and DDR protocols, Cadence and Synopsys tools such as VCS, Xcelium, Innovus and PrimeTime, Tcl and Perl scripting, ASIC and SoC tape-outs.

manufacturing.label: Manufacturing / Process Engineering
manufacturing.title: Manufacturing Engineer
manufacturing.description: Manufacturing and process engineer improving production: lean manufacturing, kaizen, 5S, value stream mapping and SMED, Six Sigma DMAIC, SPC and process capability, PFMEA and control plans, APQP and PPAP, 8D, CAPA and root cause analysis, line balancing and cycle time reduction, work instructions, ISO 9001 or IATF 16949, ERP/MES, tooling and EHS.

ux_designer.label: UI / UX Design
ux_designer.title: UI/UX Designer
ux_designer.description: UI/UX and product designer creating usable, accessible digital products: user research, interviews and usability testing, personas and journey maps, information architecture and user flows, wireframes and interactive prototypes in Figma, visual and UI design, design systems and components, interaction design, accessibility to WCAG, analytics and close collaboration with product and engineering.

graphic_designer.label: Graphic / Visual Design
graphic_designer.title: Graphic Designer
graphic_designer.description: Graphic and visual designer creating brand and marketing visuals: Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator and InDesign, branding and logo design, typography and layout, print and packaging design, social media and digital ad creatives, illustration, motion graphics and video editing in After Effects and Premiere Pro, brand guidelines and Figma.

web_designer.label: Web Design
web_designer.title: Web Designer
web_designer.description: Web designer building attractive, responsive websites: HTML5, CSS3 and JavaScript with Bootstrap or Tailwind, responsive and mobile-first layouts, WordPress, Shopify or Webflow, Figma and Adobe Photoshop mockups, UI design, basic SEO, web accessibility, landing pages and site maintenance.

product_mgr.label: Product Management
product_mgr.title: Product Manager
product_mgr.head: Product
product_mgr.description: Product manager owning outcomes for a product: product strategy, vision and roadmap, customer discovery and market research, prioritisation, PRDs, user stories and acceptance criteria, working with engineering and design in Agile teams, product analytics, A/B experiments and KPIs such as retention and conversion, go-to-market launches, pricing and stakeholder management.

business_analyst.label: Business Analysis
business_analyst.title: Business Analyst
business_analyst.head: Business Analysis
business_analyst.description: Business analyst bridging business and technology: requirements elicitation through workshops and interviews, BRD, FRD and user stories with acceptance criteria, process mapping in BPMN and as-is to-be gap analysis, use cases and UML in Visio, SQL and Excel analysis, Power BI or Tableau dashboards, UAT planning and sign-off, Agile backlog grooming and stakeholder management.

project_mgr.label: Project / Program Management
project_mgr.title: Project Manager
project_mgr.head: Delivery
project_mgr.description: Project and program manager delivering on scope, time and budget: project planning and scheduling with MS Project or Jira, Agile and Waterfall delivery, risk, issue and dependency management with RAID logs, budget and cost control, resource planning, stakeholder and steering committee reporting, vendor and contract management, change control, PMP or PRINCE2.

scrum_master.label: Scrum Master / Agile Coach
scrum_master.title: Scrum Master
scrum_master.head: Agile Delivery
scrum_master.description: Scrum master and agile coach helping teams deliver: facilitating sprint planning, daily stand-ups, reviews and retrospectives, backlog refinement with the product owner, removing impediments, velocity, burndown and flow metrics in Jira, Kanban, coaching teams and leaders in Scrum and SAFe, PI planning and agile transformation; CSM, PSM or SAFe certifications.
